notes.title: Burger Witch - Hotfix v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]🧙‍♀️ Welcome back, Witches![/h3][p]
We hear you! [b]This is the first hotfix based on community-mentioned bugs and recommendations. We are working on an additional hotfix to include a proper grading system and the ability to select the kitchen & more.

If you have any recommendations or are experiencing issues, please reach out using the [/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3552050/discussions/"]Steam Community[/url][b] or [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]Discord[/url][b]. [/b]Thank you so much![/p][hr][/hr][h2]
Patch notes:[/h2][list][*][p]Ability to add a bun (bread) or a drink directly into a held plate.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will now have to hold the secondary interact key to cut ingredients instead of pressing multiple times (Cutting Counter).[/p][/*][*][p]Extra money bonus instead of bonus time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the name of the current map on the pause menu (temporarily) to make it easier to know which map players are in. We are releasing an update that will let players select the kitchen (or randomized) very soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b][i]This update does not require manual action; restart Steam to get the latest update automatically. [/i][/b]As always, thanks for playing and supporting us! Feel free to share your experience in the community or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/atNX56k5n7"]🎙️ Official Discord Server[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p]

notes.title: Burger Witch - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]🧙‍♀️ Welcome, Witches! To the most magical kitchen nightmare ever!
[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]Magic meets mayhem on June 24th, 2025![/h3][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="B3MexTkkhhw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h3]You are invited to be a burger witch![/h3][p]
Step into the sizzling chaos of Burger Witch, where haunted kitchens meet magical mayhem! As a broom-wielding chef trapped in a cursed dungeon, you’ll conjure burgers, dodge disasters, and brew spells in frantic, fast-paced rounds. Upgrade your kitchen, follow ancient witchy burger recipes, and survive the heat, solo or with a friend in local co-op. 

[/p][list][*][p]🍔Fast-Paced Co-op Chaos: Team up with friends to cook, assemble, and serve enchanted burgers before time runs out, emphasizing cooperative gameplay.
[/p][/*][*][p]🔪Upgrade Your Tools: Earn gold to enhance your kitchen, unlock new magical cooking gadgets, and improve efficiency, allowing for better performance in subsequent rounds.
[/p][/*][*][p]📔The Witchcraft Book: Follow the ancient (and slightly absurd) rules of mystical burger assembly, where style matters as much as speed.
[/p][/*][*][p]⌛Challenging Time Management: You must juggle potion brewing, ingredient prep, and burger assembly under time.
Whimsical Art Style: The game boasts colorful, cartoonish visuals that perfectly complement its lighthearted and magical tone.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Burger Witch blends cooperative chaos with a whimsical witchcraft twist. Take orders, assemble burgers with style, and serve mystical customers before time runs out. Earn gold to upgrade your tools, expand your kitchen, and prepare for even greater challenges!
